package.name: g1_sensor_relay
package.description: Publishes sensor data sampled inside the patched unitree_mujoco. The simulator computes the sweep against its own mjData and hands finished frames over a local socket; this node turns them into ROS 2 messages. The split exists because unitree_sdk2 already owns the CycloneDDS domain in that process and rmw_cyclonedds cannot share it. See README.
